§6Scraps§f

§aGarbage from structures and machines. Most of it is useless. Some of it is gold.§f

Scraps come in several varieties, each with different origins and uses.

§bScrap§f: Found in chests or salvaged from structures with an anvil. Burns as fuel (1 second in a TU generator) or crafts into a Scrap Block (2-3 seconds of burn time).

§bPlastic Scraps§f: Shred bobbleheads to get these. Smelt them into §bPolymer Bars§f. This is your early-game polymer source before petrochemical production is online.

§bOily Scraps§f: Shred cracked stone, oily sand, red oily sand, dead dirt, porous stone, or oily dirt. Crafts into §bArsenic Nuggets§f.

§bRadioactive Scraps§f: Shred sellafite or broken ZIRNOX fuel elements. No current use, just waste.

§bCMB Scrap Metal§f: Dropped by the Hunter Chopper. Smelt into §bCMB Steel Ingots§f.

§ePS:§f Plastic Scraps are the most useful. Save CMB Scrap for CMB Steel.
